Based on a federal requirement, the Nicolet Psychiatric Center (NPC) hospital unit at the Brown County Community Treatment Center (CTC) is required to make available a list of current standard charges via the Internet in a machine readable format. To view the 2026 Standard Charges, please click this link: 2026 Standard Charges.
